name: From Kashmir to the Kargil Highlands
description: A mountain-road proposal with deliberate pacing and flexible pass crossings.

itinerary.title: Srinagar
itinerary.description: Arrive, meet the arranged transfer, and keep the first afternoon open around your journey.

itinerary.title: Sonamarg
itinerary.description: Travel to Sonamarg for a gentle afternoon and preparation for the onward road.

itinerary.title: Kargil
itinerary.description: Cross towards Kargil only if the road is open and individual suitability has been assessed.

itinerary.title: Kargil surroundings
itinerary.description: Keep a locally coordinated cultural day with suitable rest time.

itinerary.title: Kargil valley day
itinerary.description: Explore an approved valley excursion or retain the day as a weather buffer.

itinerary.title: Srinagar
itinerary.description: Return over the confirmed route. Conditions may require a different plan or extra time.

itinerary.title: Srinagar departure
itinerary.description: Return for the agreed departure transfer. Allow a sensible road buffer before onward travel.
